text_block_list.text: On the way home from an outing with Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The sky is... getting cloudy.
It might start raining soon.
choice_data_list: Shall we hurry on home?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, getting soaked would be terrible.
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...It ended up raining after all.
At least we managed to find shelter for now.
choice_data_list: It's probably just a passing shower, so let's take a break.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "Huh, really? Thank you!"

Buena Vista has disliked the rain ever since she was a little girl.
And even now, that hasn't changed—

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
And here we had a special outing planned, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Ugh...
And here we had a special outing planned, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
The road and my clothes are all soaking wet...
It's so cold, and I feel so lonely...
choice_data_list: Are you lonely? ...Why?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know. But I don't want to.
If Boo-chan gets wet from the rain or snow,
he gets all sad and droopy..."

While sheltering from the rain, we reminisced.
Though it was about when she was very young... it seems
how she feels about the rain hasn't changed a bit.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even now, I still don't really know why...
I just couldn't control this overwhelming
feeling of loneliness no matter what.
choice_data_list: Everyone has things they're not good at, so—

text_block_list.text: I encouraged Buena Vista, telling her she didn't need to force herself to overcome it, hoping to lighten her load.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but is your work okay?
You probably have things to do back at the office,
so maybe we really should head back.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm all grown up now, so getting a little wet won't hurt me at all!

"Indeed, there's plenty to do.
I want to analyze the data on our upcoming races
and tailor training routines to match."
choice_data_list: Still, we've got enough leeway to wait for rain.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You're as kind as ever.
But that's exactly why I want to change!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to do my best to overcome it someday,
so that getting soaked by rain or snow won't bother me at all—
Oh?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I see, I totally get it. Lots of girls get all sentimental on rainy days!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Normally I'm totally hunky-dory even in the rain, but...
sometimes I remember those lonely days and feel a little wistful.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh? You too, Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yes, but you know, there's a saying:
"After the rain comes bright sunshine!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Even if something totally bogus happens, it'll lead to a nice future!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Because no rain lasts forever.
Besides, if you think back really carefully,
there must have been plenty of wonderful memories, too."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Ugh... I feel so lonely...
choice_data_list: If you're lonely... I'll always stay by your side.
If you're lonely... I'll always stay by your side.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big Brother did...?
choice_data_list: I'll stay with Buena until she's not lonely anymore.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Big Sister did...?
choice_data_list: I'll stay with Buena until she's not lonely anymore.

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text: Really...?

text_block_list.name: Young Buena
text_block_list.text:
Until the rain stops...
will you stay by Bu-chan's side?
choice_data_list: Ah, it's a promise!
Yeah, it's a promise!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That's certainly true.
It wasn't just painful memories...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Big Brother made me... such a kind promise.
So why did I end up forgetting it?"
choice_data_list: It kept raining for a while after that, after all...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister made... a sweet promise with me.
So why did I end up forgetting it?
choice_data_list: It kept raining for a while after that, after all...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...
Ugh, maybe my lonely feelings just got the better of me... Sorry.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Looks like the rain has stopped.
Maybe I should head home with Tacchan too!
choice_data_list: Maruzensky, I have a favor to ask!
Shall we head back, Buena!

text_block_list.text: Judging by the weather forecast website checked on my smartphone, even if it's clear now, there's no telling when it might start raining again. So—
choice_data_list: Buena, would you come with me to see them off?
Buena, will you come with me to see them off?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Huh!?
choice_data_list: It might rain again, so... please!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"All right, leave it to me☆
Buena-chan, shouldn't we take into account his feelings for you?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"All right, leave it to me☆
Buena-chan, shouldn't we take into account her feelings for you?"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...See ya.
Um... Trainer, you take care too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Buena-chan.
...What a wonderful childhood friend he is."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Buena-chan.
...What a wonderful childhood friend she is."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
That person always gives me strength.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, thanks to Maruzen-san's story,
I think I might be able to push through rainy days...
just a little better than before."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu!
A hunky-dory ending, isn't it♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ufufu. You two get along so well, it's wonderful.
Well then, I shall take my leave first.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you so much for today.
Please get home safe!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes, ba-bye☆

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...The sky after the rain is so pretty, isn't it?
choice_data_list: Yeah.
Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm glad we could go out today.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Being able to talk with Maruzen-san
and remember our old promise—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even on rainy days, maybe now...
I won't feel quite as lonely as before.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
The promise we made that rainy day...
This time, I'll never ever forget it.
